title: Preservation of filtered colimits by tensor totalization
statement: Let C be a small category, J a Grothendieck topology on C, and R a sheaf of commutative rings on J. For every filtered category I and every cochain complex P of sheaves of R-modules, the functor obtained by tensoring a variable cochain complex with P, forming the associated bicomplex, and applying the totalization functor preserves colimits of shape I. Equivalently, the canonical comparison from the colimit of the totalized tensor complexes to the totalization of the colimit tensor complex is an isomorphism.

source.place: Lemmas 03DB (limits and colimits of O-modules) and 03EP (tensor product commutes with colimits)

proof.text: Tensoring with a fixed sheaf of modules preserves colimits because the sheaf-module category is symmetric monoidal closed and tensoring is a left adjoint, by [lem-pc-sheaf-modules-tensor-closed]. Applying this degreewise gives the canonical colimit comparison for every entry of the tensor bicomplex.

The totalization in each degree is a coproduct over pairs of bicomplex degrees with fixed sum. Colimits commute with coproducts, so the degreewise comparisons assemble to an isomorphism after totalization. Naturality of the tensor maps makes the comparison commute with the signed total differential, hence it is a comparison of cochain complexes and proves preservation of the canonical filtered colimit.
